route_note: Buses run directly from Phnom Penh to Kampong Cham in roughly 2.5-3 hours along National Road 6/7.
tour_query: Kampong Cham day trip from Phnom Penh

route_note: Take a local bus or shared taxi about 1.5 hours northwest of Phnom Penh, then a short moto or tuk-tuk ride up to the mountain.
tour_query: Oudong day trip from Phnom Penh

route_note: A short tuk-tuk or taxi ride to the Mekong ferry crossing, then a brief boat hop to the island, all within about an hour of the city.
